prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Input image 1 is a CONTENT AND FUNCTIONAL REFERENCE: a full scrolling screenshot of the existing Chinese iPhone app 多多打卡. It is NOT an aesthetic template to copy. Redesign this homepage into one beautiful, complete, high fidelity vertically scrolling mobile game-like habit tracker concept, genuinely delightful and easy for a six-year-old to use. Deliver ONE finished UI DESIGN IMAGE, tall portrait approximately 1:3 aspect ratio, at the highest practical resolution. No phone hardware frame, no angled perspective, no design annotations or external marketing headings.

Creative direction: “熊猫宇航员的星球闯关”. A premium illustrated children's adventure app: a friendly plush baby panda astronaut, miniature soft clay planets, a small rocket on a launchpad, tiny earned star tokens, tactile rounded toy buttons. A coherent light ivory/lavender space background with restrained dotted orbital trails connecting FOUR colorful mission outposts. Storybook-quality 3D clay illustrations plus exceptionally crisp native-like UI. The page feels like entering a playful adventure rather than filling out a form. Big readable Chinese task names, recognizable pictograms for children, generous touch targets, strong hierarchy, consistent rounded typography. Rich but organized. Leave breathing space around labels. Flat front view, clean professional product design.

Keep ALL 17 tasks and the exact order and group names below. Each of the four groups is a charming distinct miniature space outpost with its own small themed illustration/header, then a compact two-column grid of task tiles. Odd last tiles can be centered full-width compact missions; avoid empty half-row gaps. Task icon illustrations large and charming, with small point-star tokens. The cards must look pressable. Do not turn the whole screen into a confusing winding game path with scattered labels. Connect the four organized sections with a subtle little exploration route. No independent mini-game or unrelated feature.

Top:
Navigation title “多多打卡”, small rules icon left, parent shield icon right.
Hero: panda pilot waving beside a toy rocket and an inviting short line “今天也要闪闪发光！”.
An exciting rocket-fuel progress meter labeled “6 / 13” and “再得7分，飞船就能出发啦！”. This means confirmed effective points, NOT spending balance. Three neat small counters exactly “今日自评 7”, “有效打卡 6”, “奖励分 0”. Clear small parent action “家长确认”.
Below hero, “我的星际旅程” as a beautifully illustrated miniature solar-system route with locked planet nodes, a rocket marker and short labels “本月 6 / 50” and “每50分解锁星球”. Small treasure-shaped goal reward visual is fine but no invented extra currency.
Avoid huge walls of explanatory text.

Four outposts with exact main accent colors:
1. “能量补给站” #FF8D28: 起床 +1 (completed/confirmed, show small subtle check-stamp and “07:12”); 吃早饭 +1 (completed/confirmed, show stopwatch and “25:11/30”); 吃午饭 +1 (unstarted, “30分钟”, action “开始”); 吃晚饭 +1 (unstarted, “30分钟”, “开始”); 睡觉 +1 (unstarted, “晚上9:30”, “打卡”).
2. “知识探索站” #B0A0FF: 认真听讲 +2 (completed/confirmed); 写作业 +2 (currently timing, animated-looking timer icon with ONLY elapsed text “12:36”, prominent “结束” button); 阅读 +2 (unstarted, “至少15分钟”, “开始”).
3. “生活空间站” #00D2E0: 收拾玩具 +1 (completed/confirmed); 打扫卫生 +1 (unstarted “打卡”); 洗漱 +1 (unstarted, “晚上9:00”, “打卡”); 干净卫生 +1 (completed, waiting for parent, show “待确认”); 自己穿衣 +1 (completed/confirmed).
4. “勇气成长站” #FF375F: 乖巧听话 +2 (unstarted “打卡”); 不发脾气 +2 (unstarted “打卡”); 做事不拖拉 +2 (locked, lock icon, short “三餐、作业后解锁”); 诚实守信 +1 (unstarted “打卡”).

Completed confirmed missions: light mint-tinted successful tile, small golden earned star, subtle translucent approval-check stamp in unused upper-right space, short “已完成”. Waiting parent: “待确认”, no approval stamp. Unstarted: calm tinted themed tile, bright main action. Active homework: attractive pulse/radar timer motif and clear “结束”. No duplicated state badges “未打卡/计时中/已打卡” above content. Each tile shows a single meaningful action/state. Never obscure title or timer with artwork or stamp. Illustration differentiation should instantly communicate each habit.

Bottom: small friendly panda trail ending and “每天一点点，成长看得见。” Then ONE persistent bottom tab bar design with exactly “今日打卡”, “打卡统计”, “积分消耗”; first selected. Do not repeat navigation bars mid-page.

Make it a polished, joyful, achievable product design for a real iPhone app, not a poster or sticker sheet. The main aim is strong child motivation, curiosity, visible progression, and proud achievement. Chinese characters clean and spelled correctly. Exact task names and point values must be retained, all four sections fully visible from top to bottom. Total possible daily points 23; target stays 13. No ads, purchases, timers creating pressure, leaderboards, or new account flows.

Use case: text-localization / precise-object-edit. This image is the EDIT TARGET. Keep this beautiful entire tall Chinese children's app UI design pixel-for-pixel in spirit: preserve all illustrations, composition, dimensions, spacing, task titles, 17 tasks, card colors, panda poses, backgrounds, buttons, counters and bottom tabs. Only correct the following UI information labels; do not redesign or add anything:
1. Orange 能量补给站 header progress currently incorrectly says 0 / 5 已完成. Replace with exactly "2 / 5 已完成".
2. Purple 知识探索站 header progress currently incorrectly says 0 / 5 已完成. Replace with exactly "1 / 3 已完成".
3. Cyan 生活空间站 header progress replace with exactly "3 / 5 已完成".
4. Pink 勇气成长站 keep exactly "0 / 4 已完成".
5. In 我的星际旅程, change the four planet name labels in left-to-right order to the actual solar-system planets "水星", "金星", "地球", "火星". Keep 6 / 50 beneath the first planet as progress toward unlocking it, keep the other three visibly locked with 未解锁. Keep 本月 6 / 50 and 每50分解锁星球. No fantasy planet names.
All other Chinese text and visuals unchanged. Full image, no cropping. Crisp Chinese typography, high fidelity.
